description: Loosest object and candidate thresholds of the 4-lepton event records (h4l_reco).  Every threshold the final selection (AN values or the stage-4b optimization) may use lies above these floors; lepton pT floors apply to the calibrated pT and stay at least 20 % below any analysis threshold (the calibration moves pT by about 2 %, the MC smearing by a few %).  Values of AN-16-442 sections 3-4 where the AN has them.

leptons.comment: AN loose leptons; muons global or tracker with a matched station; ghost_dr: of two muons closer than this the PF (else the higher-pT) one is kept, a substitute for the AN segment-sharing ghost cleaning; overlap_dr: the AN electron-muon cross-cleaning cone (applied downstream against selected muons)

fsr.comment: AN FSR photons (muons only, the NanoAOD FsrPhoton collection); removed from the neutral isolation of every loose lepton within iso_veto_dr < dR < iso_dr

event.comment: an event is kept with at least min_leptons loose leptons and an opposite-sign same-flavour pair with m(ll gamma) in z_mass (Z+l fake-rate region and every 4-lepton region)

candidates.comment: floors below the AN values (SIP 4, Z1 40-120, Z2 12-120 (4 for Z->4l), pT 20/10, dR 0.02, m(OS) 4 without FSR, m4l 70)

jets.comment: AN jets (pT > 30, |eta| < 4.7); UL NanoAOD Jet_jetId has no loose bit, the tight bit (2) substitutes the AN loose jet ID
